room_rent.display: Single Private A.C. Room (up to Deluxe)
room_rent.note: Optional add-on (3.4.11) allows downgrade to Twin Sharing for a discount. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room chosen.

icu.note: Policy explicitly states ICU charges shall not be proportionately reduced in all cases.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on base plan. Voluntary co-payment available as optional add-on (3.4.1) for premium discount.

sub_limits.display: Special treatments capped at 50% SI (SI <10L); Transportation ₹500/hosp
sub_limits.note: Special treatments (robotic, HIFU, etc.) sub-limited to 50% of SI for SI <10L, 100% for SI >=10L. Transportation benefit capped at ₹500 per hospitalisation. No other disease-wise sub-limits found.

deductible.note: Voluntary aggregate deductible available as optional add-on (3.4.13) in options of ₹10,000/₹25,000/₹50,000/₹1,00,000.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; waived after 12 months continuous coverage. COVID-19 has a 15-day waiting period.

ped_waiting.note: Reducible to 24 or 12 months via optional paid add-on (3.4.9).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Covers ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, eye conditions and others. Reducible to 12 months via optional add-on (3.4.10).

maternity.display: Optional add-on (12 or 24 mo wait; 3-yr policy only)
maternity.note: Maternity Cover (3.4.4.1) is an optional paid add-on. Limit: ₹1L (SI 5L) or ₹1L/₹2L (SI >=10L). Max 2 deliveries lifetime. Available only on 3-year policy period. Waiting period 12 or 24 months as opted.

cumulative_bonus.note: Policy mentions 'Stay Healthy Discount' of up to 10% on renewal premium for health check-up submission, but no traditional cumulative bonus / NCB on sum insured is described in the wording.

restoration.note: Base Restore Benefit (3.1.11): once per policy year, 100% of SI, for unrelated illness only. Unlimited Restore (3.4.2.2) available as optional paid add-on: unlimited restorations; SI >=10L covers related and unrelated illness.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day care procedures covered; diagnostic-only day care excluded.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if condition continues for at least 3 continuous days.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered as inpatient in recognised AYUSH hospital; cashless on best-effort basis.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered within SI, subject to Transplantation of Human Organs Act compliance.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered within SI; intercity ambulance also covered. Air ambulance available as optional paid add-on (3.4.3.2).

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern/special treatments listed (robotic surgery, stereotactic, HIFU, etc.) covered; capped at 50% of SI for SI <10L, 100% for SI >=10L.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items (Annexure A List I) excluded by default; covered if Consumables Cover add-on is opted.

global_cover.display: Optional (MoreGlobal add-on, up to SI or ₹50L for planned)
global_cover.note: MoreGlobal (3.2.3) is a More Options Benefit chosen at inception at no extra premium (one complementary benefit). Covers emergency and planned overseas treatment up to SI (planned capped at ₹50L). Available up to 45 days cumulative international travel per year.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Peritoneal dialysis, hormone replacement therapy, hazardous activities, external congenital anomaly, spinal manipulation, self-injury, nuclear/bio/chemical attack

optional_riders.display: Unlimited Restore, Consumables Cover, Maternity+Newborn, OPD (Plan A/B), Air Ambulance, Double Cover, Super Charger, MoreGlobal, Home Care, DME/Small Equipment, Voluntary Deductible, PED waiting reduction
